name: split-hero-diagonal
title: Split Hero Diagonal
description: Modern landing hero section with angled diagonal polygon dividing the typography from visual canvas.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Brutalist
Macrostructure: Split
Density: Airy
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Diagonal Split Hero: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
